propositions: Cloud's AcliClient.update_issue must route empty assignee (None or "") to unassign_issue() instead of passing --assignee to ACLI
When update_issue is called with assignee="" or assignee=None, unassign_issue must be invoked exactly once and no workitem edit subprocess spawned for assignee alone
When update_issue co-submits empty assignee with other editable fields (e.g., summary), unassign_issue must fire and a workitem edit argv must carry the other field(s) with NO --assignee flag
A non-empty assignee must bypass unassign_issue and send --assignee with the validated accountId in the workitem edit argv
